description: Update one Xray Cloud Test Run status. The Test Run is selected by Test Execution and Test Jira keys after bounded registration polling.

executionKey.description: Jira issue key of the Test Execution that owns the Test Run.

status.description: Xray Test Run status name or identifier.

testKey.description: Jira issue key of the Test represented by the Test Run.

name: update_xray_test_run_status

error.description: The actionable root failure returned when Test Run registration or status update fails.

executionId.description: Numeric Jira issue identifier of the Test Execution.

executionKey.description: Resolved Jira issue key of the Test Execution.

message.description: A stable summary returned when Test Run registration or status update fails.

testId.description: Numeric Jira issue identifier of the Test.

testKey.description: Resolved Jira issue key of the Test.

testRunId.description: Opaque Xray identifier of the updated Test Run.
